name: io.github.renderedfits/open-data
title: Rendered Fits open data
description: Clothing size conversion, fashion sizing statistics and AI crawler benchmarks, with citations.

tools.name: convert_clothing_size
tools.description: Convert a size label between sizing systems (UK, US, EU/FR, AU, IT, JP, chest/waist/collar in inches or cm) for women's clothing, women's jeans, men's suits and jackets, men's shirts, men's trousers, women's shoes, men's shoes and children's clothing. Returns the equivalent labels in every system for that size, the table it came from and a source link. Leave `to` empty to get all systems.

from.description: Sizing system of the size you have, e.g. "uk", "us", "eu", "ukus" (inches), "cm", "w" (jeans waist), "age".

size.description: The size label to convert, e.g. "12", "40", "15.5", "28".

tools.name: list_size_tables
tools.description: List the available size conversion tables, their sizing systems and every size label each one covers.

tools.name: search_fashion_statistics
tools.description: Search original, dated statistics published by Rendered Fits: how Shopify fashion stores publish size charts and fit notes, what AI shopping assistants receive about sizing, what a UK size 12 measures across retailers, and which AI crawlers fashion sites allow. Each result has the figure, its sample and date, the source page, a DOI where one exists and a ready-to-use citation. Empty query returns all.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "size chart image", "size 12 hips", "GPTBot", "fit notes".

tools.name: list_open_datasets
tools.description: List the open datasets Rendered Fits publishes (size chart audit, AI sizing study, size 12 measurements, AI crawler access and more) with descriptions, licence, DOI, mirrors and CSV downloads.

tools.name: get_ai_crawler_benchmark
tools.description: Benchmark from Rendered Fits' AI crawler access study: the share of Shopify fashion stores and of major fashion retailers whose robots.txt blocks each AI crawler (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others), and how many publish an llms.txt.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Read a website's public robots.txt now and report, for each major AI crawler and assistant (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Apple, Amazon, Meta, Common Crawl, ByteDance) and for Googlebot and Bingbot, whether its home page and product pages are allowed, partly blocked or blocked. Compares the result with the fashion benchmark. Reads one file; does not crawl the site.

tools.name: about_rendered_fits
tools.description: Facts about Rendered Fits, the Shopify app for size recommendations, Complete the Look and AI virtual try-on: what it does, its limits, current pricing terms and official links.
